dodgy GP, I had to pay £30 to the receptionist for a sick note. I later found out from other family members that they never had to pay for a sick note.

I was genuinely in pain unable to be in the office and they charged me £30. On top of this, they scribbled a bunch of words on a paper instead of typing it on the computer and giving me a professional printed paper. My workplace almost didn't accept it and said they never received a sick note like this before.

I don't know if the receptionist decided to write it herself or if the doctor is just after everyones money.

To add on, I have been with family members to other GP's and they are so much more helpful and welcoming, I was experiencing something after a holiday but it wasn't serious, the Dr in a gp I wasn't even registered in decided to take a look and tried to help. This GP is very dodgy and I don't know how they're still open.

I would have given 0 stars but 1 star is the only option available. Stay away from this place.

And the fact that there are so many bad reviews and they're not even doing anything to change things! Or even get new staff ! This is absolutely ridiculous. I'm glad I moved to another GP.
